learning_outcomes.text: Know the innovation management strategies currently applied in mechanical engineering and assume the need for it.
Know the advantages, disadvantages, and consequences of industry digitalization processes, as well as the strategies to adopt to successfully carry them out.

syllabus_topics: Need for permanent innovation in industry.
Digitalization processes in industry: motivation, advantages, and consequences.
Strategies for implementing digitalization in industry.
The Importance of a Digital Transformation Strategy
Awareness phase: Presence and being active
The Difference in a World Digital: Innovation vs Transformation
How to promote Innovation and Transformation in Business
assessment_rules: Continuous assessment consists of two partial exams: the first covers Topic 1 and is held mid-semester, and the second covers Topic 2 and is held in the last week of the course. The average grade of both exams must be 5 or higher to pass the course. For ordinary and extraordinary evaluations, partial grades are not kept, and the student must take the exam covering the entire course content.
bibliography: Rocci Lupiccini. Interdisciplinary Approaches to Digital Transformation and Innovation. Editorial Advisory Board. ISBN: 9781799818793
David L. Rogers. The Digital Transformation Playbook: Rethink Your Business for the Digital Age. Columbia University Press. ISBN: 9780231175449
